name: openworkgraph-local
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the compact local OpenWorkGraph context surface.
long_description: Uses the OpenWorkGraph installation already running on this computer. v0.111 adds opt-in provenance-safe Working Detail for agent continuity: workspace-relative files, structured command/test facts, repository state and bounded redacted error facts can enrich the existing grounded handoff without storing raw tool output or hidden reasoning; historical import is explicit and AI read permission remains separate. v0.110 makes the compact MCP initialize with evidence-first, full-period paging and current-agent automation guidance; it ships the frontier-aware automation prompt/resource from v0.109 main, adds a packaged MCPB smoke check, and gives genuinely undecided new users a local-only 7-day history grace period without granting saved-history AI access. v0.109 adds default-off native Claude Code/Codex session observation and grounded cross-agent continuity while keeping visible messages in a separate opt-in channel. Canonical workflow evidence remains primary; Working Detail is untrusted observed context with provenance and is never promoted to policy or canonical evidence. The legacy 24-tool MCP entrypoint remains available for existing configurations while new connections use this compact surface.

tools.name: get_current_work_context
tools.description: Read an optional compact derived overview with pointers to canonical evidence.

tools.name: get_context_pulse
tools.description: Read what changed since the last check plus new or materially changed factual findings; pass the returned cursor back next time.

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: Navigate retained human and agent sessions within the saved-history date range the user explicitly allowed.

tools.name: search_work
tools.description: Search prior work through evidence or semantic layers.

tools.name: get_workflow_trace
tools.description: Read the primary canonical paginated workflow evidence, optionally for one session or date range.

tools.name: get_work_profile
tools.description: Read derived workflow signals without productivity scoring.

tools.name: find_repeated_workflows
tools.description: Find repeated-work candidates and exact procedural-memory family keys for follow-up.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Read a bounded task-context bundle with provenance and authority separation.

tools.name: how_did_similar_runs_go
tools.description: Read descriptive prior-run feedback with privacy-safe human step labels, failure points, approval hotspots and observed next steps.

tools.name: get_agent_runs
tools.description: List privacy-safe structural agent runs; saved-history leases bound historical date access.

tools.name: get_agent_handoff
tools.description: Read a grounded prior-agent handoff: canonical structural execution plus separately permitted provenance-safe Working Detail and visible messages.

tools.name: get_playbooks
tools.description: Read shared content-free playbooks (how a kind of work usually went); own workflows need saved-history access.
